sentence: This project builds tools and workflows for genome assembly and analysis that biology researchers can use.
This project studies how gene interactions and temperature jointly influence plant traits in the model plant Arabidopsis.
This project builds a computational model that uses physics to predict deformation and failure in fractured rock masses.
This project builds networks of quantum sensors and uses machine learning to measure weak signals across distributed systems.
This project studies how neurons change the assembly of an antioxidant protein when they encounter oxidative stress.
This project tests whether skin bacteria help tadpoles defend against pathogens before the immune system is mature.
This project builds a framework to check and measure how private information leaks through the behaviors of multi-robot systems.
This project studies the impact of individual differences, host movement and spatial variations on disease transmission in a lizard-malaria system.
This project tests whether the stereocilia membrane regulates amplification and filtering of sound by the sensory hair bundle.
This project studies how yeast cells sense the direction of a chemical source to locate mating partners.
This project studies atomic-scale changes in copper-based bimetallic nanocatalysts during carbon dioxide conversion using liquid cell electron microscopy.
This project builds a privacy approach for decentralized optimization that protects sensitive information without compromising optimization accuracy.
This project builds a learning-based framework that lets drones learn from the experience of other drones.
This project tries to find out what the bacteria living inside plant-parasitic nematodes do to the worms and to plants.
This project builds a platform that converts cell phone location records into measures of mobility across neighborhoods.
This project tests whether extreme weather reduces forest productivity by increasing competitive interactions among trees.
